integrations.purpose: Repository, pull-request and CI access when a suitable connector or authenticated CLI is unavailable
integrations.fallback: Existing GitHub connector or authenticated gh CLI
integrations.setup: Connect the official endpoint using the client's supported authentication. Enable only required toolsets. Verify needed operations; GitHub access does not imply every operation is exposed.

integrations.purpose: Version-aligned Angular guidance, documentation and workspace inspection
integrations.fallback: Project Angular CLI, official documentation and existing checks
integrations.setup: Install the project's locked dependencies first. Use its own Angular CLI; begin read-only. Documentation search needs internet; --local-only excludes online tools.

integrations.purpose: Interactive browser investigation, controls, screenshots and reproducible UI workflows
integrations.fallback: Existing browser tools or Playwright CLI/tests
integrations.setup: Select a reviewed exact package version and install its required browser. Prefer existing browser access when sufficient. Canvas geometry needs screenshots and numerical checks; snapshots alone do not verify it.

integrations.purpose: Task-specific browser debugging and performance investigation
integrations.fallback: Existing browser DevTools or browser automation
integrations.setup: Select a reviewed exact version and a dedicated browser profile. Enable when performance/debugging work needs it; avoid duplicating an adequate browser connection.

integrations.purpose: Parametric modeling in an existing Fusion desktop workflow
integrations.fallback: Fusion's supported local automation and manual model checks
integrations.setup: Fusion must be installed and running with Preferences > General > API > MCP enabled. Obtain the actual local endpoint from Fusion; do not confuse this with the cloud Data MCP. Verify access to a non-sensitive test document.

integrations.purpose: Modeling and inspection in an existing Blender workflow
integrations.setup: Follow the official Blender Lab requirements, add-on and server instructions for the installed version. Review generated-code execution access. No default launch command is assumed.
